contentText: It may still be November but it's beginning to look a lot like Christmas in South London, as many Santa impersonators are heading to school for their festive training. The school, organised by an event company called Ministry of Fun, brings together Santas, elves, and Mrs Clauses to share experiences, practice belly laughs and learn how to bring the magic of Christmas to life. Story by Rachael Griffiths.
